knowledge_base.details: The Dashboard is your main hub, showing widgets for a complete overview of your power usage, finances, and system status.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: From the home screen, navigate to the Dashboard to view and interact with all your energy widgets. You can also click 'Suggest Plan' to get an AI-powered recommendation for a subscription plan based on your usage.

knowledge_base.details: Your Profile Details section is where you can manage and update your personal information.
steps: Navigate to 'Profile Details' from your user menu.
Edit your personal information, such as name or contact details.
Save the changes.

knowledge_base.details: You can add credit to your power account through the Top Up feature. This includes standard top-ups and setting up automatic recharges.
steps: Go to the 'Top Up' screen.
Enter the amount you wish to add (minimum R50).
Enter any promo or voucher codes you have.
Complete the payment to add the funds to your account.

knowledge_base.details: Auto Top-Up automatically adds funds to your account when your balance gets low.
steps: On the 'Top Up' screen, find the 'Auto Top-Up' settings.
Specify a minimum balance that will trigger the top-up.
Set the amount you want to automatically add.
Save your settings.

knowledge_base.details: The Expenses feature allows you to track your power-related spending, with summaries for total expenses and your monthly average.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Navigate to the 'Expenses' page to see a list of your recent transactions and their status (e.g., Paid, Pending).

knowledge_base.details: The Notifications screen displays all important alerts and updates about your account, such as low balance warnings or system maintenance.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Go to the 'Notifications' page to see your recent alerts. You can dismiss them from this screen.

knowledge_base.details: The Settings section is where you manage your account security and preferences.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Navigate to the 'Settings' page to change your password, update your notification preferences (SMS/Email), or delete your account.

knowledge_base.details: The Impact page shows your positive effect on the environment from using solar energy, including your CO₂ reduction.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Go to the 'Impact' page to see your stats, read community stories, submit your own testimonial, and download a PDF of your impact report.

knowledge_base.details: The Support Center is your destination for help, featuring a FAQ and a direct contact form.
steps: Go to the 'Support' page.
Browse the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for answers.
If you can't find an answer, fill out the contact form to create a support ticket.

knowledge_base.details: Our AI provides personalized tips to help you save energy and manage your finances.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: On the 'AI Suggestions' page, you can interact with tips by voting, commenting, adding to favorites, or sharing them. You can also search and filter tips by category.

knowledge_base.details: The Forum is a community space for discussions with other GridX users.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Go to the 'Forum' page to read topics or post messages. For long discussions, you can use the 'Summarize' feature. You can also use 'Check Tone' to review your post before submitting.

knowledge_base.details: Our Refer & Earn program lets you earn rewards by inviting friends to GridX.
steps: Go to the 'Refer & Earn' page.
Copy your unique referral link.
Share it with friends directly or through social media.

knowledge_base.details: You can manage your energy subscription plan from the Subscriptions page.
steps: Go to the 'Subscriptions' page to see all available plans.
Click 'Select Plan' on your desired plan.
Complete the payment process to activate or change your subscription.

knowledge_base.details: Group Buying helps you save money by joining with other users to purchase solar products in bulk.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: On the 'Group Buying' page, you can either join an existing campaign or fill out the form to create a new one. You can view product details, supplier ratings, and track the campaign's progress.

knowledge_base.details: The Load Shedding feature helps you stay informed about power outages and plan your energy usage accordingly.
knowledge_base.how_to_perform: Go to the 'Load Shedding' page to view current outage schedules, check your area's status, and get real-time updates. You can also set up notifications to be alerted about upcoming outages in your area.
